description: Lists this subagent's own items across all of its turns. See [subagent workflows](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/multi-agent).

parameters.description: The ID of the subagent in this session.
parameters.name: subagent_id

parameters.description: The maximum number of resources to return, between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The order in which resources are returned. Defaults to `desc`.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Return resources after this resource ID in the selected order.
parameters.name: after

401.description: Authentication or project context was missing.

403.description: The API key lacks the required permission.

404.description: The requested session or event was not found.

409.description: The request conflicted with the current session state.

ListOrderParam.description: The order in which paginated resources are returned.

SessionItemListResource.description: A page of messages, reasoning, and tool calls from a session's item history.

data.description: The resources returned in this page, in the requested sort order.

first_id.description: The ID of the first resource in `data`, or `null` if the page is empty.

has_more.description: Whether there are more resources to retrieve after this page.

last_id.description: The ID of the last resource in `data`, or `null` if the page is empty. Pass this as `after` with the same order and filters.

object.description: The object type, which is always `list`.

error.description: The error returned by the API.

SessionTurnItemResource.description: An item associated with a session turn.

param.description: The request parameter that caused the error, or null for a request-wide error.

MessageItemResource.description: A user or assistant message recorded in a session.

content.description: The content of the message. User messages contain input text or images; assistant messages contain output text.

id.description: The ID of this item, or null for legacy user messages whose ID was not recorded.

phase.description: The phase of an assistant message. Null for user messages.

role.description: The role of the message author.

status.description: The status of the message. User messages are always `completed`.

turn_id.description: The ID of the turn that contains this item.
